 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY

ORAL ORDER 3 18-03-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.51768 of 2015(3)
dt.18-03-2023 State.

This is an application for quashing of the order dated 23.07.2015 passed by learned Judicial Magistrate, Ist Class, Patna in Phulwarisharif P.S. Case No. 776 of 2014 whereby process has been directed to be issued after cognizance being taken for the offences punishable under Sections 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
Issue notice to Opposite Party No. 2 through both processes i.e. ordinary as well as Registered Cover with A/D for which requisites etc. must be filed within two weeks failing which this application shall stand dismissed without further reference to the bench.
List this case after appearance of Opposite Party No. 2 and/or Service Report, whichever is earlier.
In the meantime, learned counsel for the petitioners shall file supplementary affidavit bringing on record the present status of the case.

(Rajiv Roy, J) Ravi/-
